description: Create a publishable key for the browser tracking SDK and return the install snippet. This is what turns on product views, cart activity, and browse abandonment for a site that is NOT Shopify or WooCommerce (custom storefronts, headless shops, marketplaces, SaaS marketing sites). Events start flowing once the snippet is deployed and nothing is backfilled for the period before that, so create and install it BEFORE building the sequence that depends on it. Always pass allowedOrigins for a website or allowedAppIds for an iOS or Android app using the mobile SDKs: a key with neither accepts anonymous events from any site or app, and a key with only allowedAppIds is rejected from browsers. Identified events require a short-lived token minted by the customer's authenticated backend through POST /api/v1/web-tracking-identities (passing the key's publicKey or keyId, plus the user's email or, for app users without one, externalId), then `sequenzy.identify(email, identityToken)` or, in the mobile SDKs, `identifyUser(externalId, ...)`; a publishable key alone can never trigger subscriber automation.

allowedAppIds.description: iOS bundle IDs and Android package names allowed to use this key from the Sequenzy mobile SDKs, e.g. ['com.example.app']. Matched case-insensitively against the x-sequenzy-app-id header on requests without an Origin header. Native apps cannot prove their identity, so this keeps a copied key from being reused by mistake; identity tokens still protect contact data.

allowedOrigins.description: Origins allowed to use this key, e.g. ['https://example.com', 'https://*.example.com']. A bare domain is read as https. A `*.` wildcard matches subdomains at any depth but NOT the apex, so list the apex separately if you need it. Include the development origin (e.g. http://localhost:3000) while wiring the SDK up. Omitting this and allowedAppIds leaves the key unrestricted, which should be a deliberate choice for a server-side caller.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name.description: Human-readable label for this key, e.g. 'Storefront' or 'Marketing site'.

name: create_web_tracking_key

key.description: The created key. installSnippet is the exact HTML snippet to paste into every page; it embeds both the publishable key and the workspace id and queues calls made while the async SDK loads.
